Resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
| extend vmSize = tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize)
| extend series = case(
    vmSize startswith 'Standard_A', 'Av2/Amv2 candidate',
    vmSize startswith 'Standard_B', 'B-series candidate',
    vmSize startswith 'Standard_D', 'D-series candidate',
    vmSize startswith 'Standard_E', 'E-series candidate',
    vmSize startswith 'Standard_F', 'F-series candidate',
    vmSize startswith 'Standard_G', 'G-series candidate',
    vmSize startswith 'Standard_L', 'L-series candidate',
    'Other')
| extend retirementScope = case(
    vmSize matches regex '^Standard_A.*v2', '1-year RI retirement',
    vmSize matches regex '^Standard_A.*mv2', '1-year RI retirement',
    vmSize matches regex '^Standard_B.*', '1-year RI retirement',
    vmSize matches regex '^Standard_D.*', '1-year RI retirement',
    vmSize matches regex '^Standard_Ds.*', '1-year RI retirement',
    vmSize matches regex '^Standard_Dv2.*', '1-year RI retirement',
    vmSize matches regex '^Standard_Dsv2.*', '1-year RI retirement',
    vmSize matches regex '^Standard_Dv3.*', '1-year and 3-year RI retirement',
    vmSize matches regex '^Standard_Dsv3.*', '1-year and 3-year RI retirement',
    vmSize matches regex '^Standard_Ev3.*', '1-year and 3-year RI retirement',
    vmSize matches regex '^Standard_Esv3.*', '1-year and 3-year RI retirement',
    vmSize matches regex '^Standard_F.*', '1-year RI retirement',
    vmSize matches regex '^Standard_Fs.*', '1-year RI retirement',
    vmSize matches regex '^Standard_Fsv2.*', '1-year RI retirement',
    vmSize matches regex '^Standard_G.*', '1-year RI retirement',
    vmSize matches regex '^Standard_Ls.*', '1-year RI retirement',
    vmSize matches regex '^Standard_Lsv2.*', '1-year RI retirement',
    'Not listed in update')
| project name, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, vmSize, series, retirementScope, id
| order by retirementScope asc, vmSize asc, name asc
| limit 200

| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
| extend vmSize = tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize)

    vmSize startswith 'Standard_Dsv2', '1-year RI retirement',
    vmSize startswith 'Standard_Dv3', '1-year and 3-year RI retirement',
    vmSize startswith 'Standard_Dsv3', '1-year and 3-year RI retirement',
    vmSize startswith 'Standard_Ev3', '1-year and 3-year RI retirement',
    vmSize startswith 'Standard_Esv3', '1-year and 3-year RI retirement',
    vmSize startswith 'Standard_F' and not(vmSize startswith 'Standard_Fx'), '1-year RI retirement candidate',
    vmSize startswith 'Standard_Fs', '1-year RI retirement',
    vmSize startswith 'Standard_Fsv2', '1-year RI retirement',
    vmSize startswith 'Standard_G', '1-year RI retirement',
    vmSize startswith 'Standard_Ls' and not(vmSize startswith 'Standard_Lsv3') and not(vmSize startswith 'Standard_Lsv4'), '1-year RI retirement candidate',
    vmSize startswith 'Standard_Lsv2', '1-year RI retirement',
    'Not listed in update')
| where retirementScope != 'Not listed in update'
| project name, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, vmSize, retirementScope, id
| order by location asc, vmSize asc, name asc
| limit 200
